entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: A strong religious state in Jamuraa on Dominaria that seceded from Zhalfir.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Land that once ruled the region entirely; later phased out by Teferi.

entities.name: Council of Voices
entities.description: The grand assembly that rules Femeref, with ten members advising the magistrate.

entities.name: Suq'Ata Empire
entities.description: Empire that annexed lands bordering Zhalfir to mine the mountains.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who phased out Zhalfir during the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Sealed the Zhalfirin time rift without Teferi's guidance.

entities.name: Sidar Teshunda
entities.description: Magistrate who ruled Femeref as of 4562.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: Esteemed Speaker who convinced Teshunda to grant the Efravans refuge.

entities.name: Phyrexian Colossus
entities.description: A Phyrexian threat that sent Femeref into infighting and paranoia.

entities.name: Terorq
entities.description: A mining city, safe haven for the Ekundu dwarves.

entities.name: Sewa
entities.description: A coastal town near the Zhalfirin Void.

events.summary: A religious dispute over the Shadow Creed's treatment of the dead leads the church to secede from Zhalfir and found Femeref.
events.quote: an internal religious dispute led the church to secede

events.summary: The Suq'Ata Empire annexes lands and mines the mountains, pushing dwarves into Femeref, which welcomes them.
events.quote: The empire annexed the lands bordering Zhalfir and began to mine the mountains

events.summary: Teferi phases out Zhalfir during the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: The land of Zhalfir was phased out by Teferi Planeswalker during the Phyrexian Invasion.

events.summary: Jeska seals the Zhalfirin time rift, dooming Zhalfir to non-existence.
events.quote: the Zhalfirin time rift was sealed by Jeska without Teferi's guidance

events.summary: Threatened by a Phyrexian Colossus, Femeref falls into infighting until Niambi convinces Teshunda to shelter the Efravans.
events.quote: It was only Esteemed Speaker Niambi who was able to convince Teshunda to grant the Efravans refuge.

relations.quote: The fledgling nation was ruled by a grand assembly known as the Council of Voices
